title: Neutrino Canonical Executable Capability Spec
description: The canonical executable capability-spec (M5 WP1d, ): the ONLY frozen external contract of the M5 architecture (ADR D1). Emitted from source alone by `neutrino-gen --target=capability-spec` (no scenario, D2) after semantic lowering; every renderer consumes THIS, not ProcedureView. Fail-closed (additionalProperties:false everywhere). Validated by scripts/validators/validate_capability_spec.py, which mirrors this schema AND enforces the beyond-schema invariants it cannot express (hash recomputation, value-category vocabulary from ValueModel/, transition endpoints resolve to declared states, compute deps resolve). Deterministic + canonical (sorted keys, no timestamps) so the capability-spec is byte-reproducible and hash-stable. See docs/spec/CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and docs/process/M5_DECISIONS_ADR.md (D1/D2/D6/D11).

valueCategory.description: A  ValueModel category name (governed set) or 'extension'.

sourceSpan.description: A 1-based DSL source location (column is 1 — the lexer is line-oriented).

targetRequirement.description: One semantic requirement the spec places on a rendering target (WP4/), with the originating primitive + source span so a legality diagnostic can name the exact line. Matching is set-intersection over `feature`. Today all are `required` with no `fallback` (both forward space, AD3).

operand.description: A debit/credit operand: a %reference to a declared input/compute, or a constant literal.

exprNode.description: A typed compute-expression AST node ( Expr). Recursive: Bin carries lhs/rhs, Call carries args. A Cmp is a guard comparison predicate (), valid only inside an effect's `when`.

terminalKind.description: For terminal states: which terminal kind (amendment). success | aborted | contested.

effects.description: Effect kinds fired on this transition. Today: post (debit/credit legs) and its inverse compensate. reserve/consume/release are reserved forward space (amendment) — not emitted until a gate sample demands them (ADR D5/AD2).

guards.description: Guards fenced on this transition. participant/deadline/sequence are the promoted guard kinds; quorum stays reserved (AD2).

evidence.description: Per-transition chained evidence obligation (amendment), or null. style: single_hash | batched_root.

attestationPolicy.description: An M-of-N oracle-consensus attestation policy on an evidence input (oracle S1, ). Only the threshold M and the observer-set REFERENCE are portable spec; the concrete N and the observer members are binding-level () and MUST NOT appear here.

input.description: the evidence input this policy governs

threshold.description: M — the acceptance threshold; N is binding-level

ref.description: observer-set identity/role reference; members are binding-level

assurance.description: declared assurance tier of the observer set (oracle S6, ); OPTIONAL — the key is present only when declared, so a pre-S6 attestation keeps its exact {ref,role} shape and capabilityHash. Undeclared (key absent) is surfaced as an advisory by the security spec.

independence.description: declared observer-set independence posture (oracle S6, ); OPTIONAL, present only when declared. correlated = shared upstream, an M-of-N single point of failure. Undeclared = advisory.

mode.description: what counts as the same claim: exact for discrete events, median for numeric feeds

tolerance.description: agreement band for numeric feeds; null for exact

timeout.description: deadline for reaching quorum; null when none

fallback.description: fail-closed behavior when quorum is not reached (degrade deferred until it names its reduced target, /S1)

schemaVersion.description: 1 by default; 2 iff any effect carries a conditional guard `when` (); 3 iff the spec carries an attestation policy (/) — a consumer that ignores it would deploy the coordination without the M-of-N guard, so a pre-3 consumer must refuse. Attestation subsumes the `when` bump (3 whether or not a `when` is also present). The validator enforces the exact conditional. A semantics-changing feature a lower-version consumer must refuse.

specVersion.description: The DSL/semantic version of the procedure (ProcedureView.version).

identity.description: Capability-spec identity + hashes (D2/D6). capabilityHash covers the PRIMARY semantic content — it excludes the identity block, the two derived line-bearing projections (sourceMap, targetRequirements), AND the envelope discriminators (kind, schemaVersion, ), so it is a pure semantic identity — formatting- and envelope-insensitive; specHash is the whole-spec digest (everything minus the hash fields). Compact canonical form is sorted-key raw UTF-8 (ensure_ascii=False). Both lowercase-hex sha256.

attestations.description: Optional (oracle S1, ): M-of-N attestation policies on evidence inputs. Present ONLY when declared, so an unattested spec is byte-identical and its capabilityHash is unchanged.

when.description: Optional conditional guard (): the leg posts iff this comparison predicate holds. Additive + backward-compatible (absent on unguarded legs).

memo.description: Optional effect metadata (M5 token S3, ): a free-text memo/reference carried WITH the movement and surfaced in each backend's emitted event/row. Metadata only — not a value type or token primitive. Additive: present ONLY when declared, so an effect without a memo is byte-identical (capabilityHash unchanged).

lifecycle.description: The one canonical coordination state machine the slot lifecycle and the on-chain surface both project from (acceptance). The fixed OPEN..CLOSE machine, extended (oracle S3, ) with an explicit M-of-N quorum gate (QUORUM_PENDING/QUORUM_MET/QUORUM_TIMEOUT + the declared abort/escalate timeout fallback) when the spec carries an attestation policy; the post departs only from QUORUM_MET, so a leg never fires on < M. The DSL has no author-defined state machines yet (L2), so it is not source-derived beyond the effect-bearing transitions and the attestation-driven quorum gate.

instanceKey.description: Composed instance key (amendment): the fields whose tuple identifies one coordination instance. `declared` is the explicit procedure-level instance key when the coordination declares one independently of its effects (absent for a legacy effect-keyed coordination).

terminalStates.description: The terminal-state kinds (amendment): which state each of success/aborted/contested maps to (null when the shape has no such terminal).

targetRequirements.description: The per-requirement records a renderer/profile is matched against BEFORE rendering (WP4/, AD3) — semantic primitives with provenance, not domain labels. Derived from the spec content, not hand-authored.

sourceMap.description: DSL -> spec JSON path map: the 1-based source span per spec construct (source is null only when an op carries no file location).
